claims.claim: KSP (ksp.co.il) is a first-party electronics retailer ('the Israeli Amazon'), not a third-party seller marketplace; it runs only an affiliate/referral program, with no public vendor 'partner API' for listing your own goods.
claims.raw_snippet: KSP sells its own electronics inventory online; its only seller-facing program is an affiliate/referral program, not a third-party vendor marketplace.

claims.claim: Yad2 (yad2.co.il) is Israel's largest site for finding second-hand goods, spanning electronics, phones, furniture, bicycles, clothing and more; it is the dominant general classifieds marketplace for C2C and business sellers.
claims.raw_snippet: האתר הגדול ביותר בישראל לחיפוש מוצרי יד שנייה. ביד2 מחכה לכם מגוון ענק של מוצרי יד שנייה לצד מוצרים חדשים: מוצרי חשמל, טלפונים ניידים, מצלמות דיגיטליות, מחשבים, ריהוט לבית ולגן, אופניים, בגדים, מוצרים ומשחקים לילדים

claims.claim: Israeli VAT is 18%, raised from 17% on 2025-01-01; consumer-facing prices for an osek murshe must include it.
claims.raw_snippet: Israel's standard VAT rate is 18% as of 2025 (raised from 17% on 1 January 2025).

claims.claim: Under the Israel Invoice (חשבוניות ישראל) reform, a tax invoice above a threshold requires a real-time allocation number (מספר הקצאה) from the Tax Authority or the buyer cannot deduct input VAT. The threshold drops over time: about NIS 20,000 in 2025, NIS 10,000 from January 2026, NIS 5,000 from mid-2026.
claims.raw_snippet: From 2024 the Israel Invoice model requires an allocation number for tax invoices above a threshold (NIS 20,000 / 20,000 ש"ח in 2025, lowering to NIS 10,000 / 10,000 ש"ח in 2026 and NIS 5,000 / 5,000 ש"ח thereafter) before input VAT may be deducted.

claims.claim: Under the Consumer Protection Law remote-sale rules, the buyer may cancel within 14 days; the cancellation fee is capped at 5% of the price or NIS 100 (whichever is lower); people with disabilities, senior citizens, and new immigrants get an extended cancellation window of up to 4 months.
claims.raw_snippet: Remote-purchase cancellation: 14 days; cancellation fee up to 5% of the transaction or NIS 100 / 100 ש"ח, whichever is lower; extended 4-month window for persons with disabilities, senior citizens, and new immigrants.

claims.claim: Zap (zap.co.il) onboards sellers via joinzap; it runs both a price-comparison model (monthly + per-click fees, no sale commission) and a marketplace model (variable per-sale commission by category).
claims.raw_snippet: Add a store to Zap: sellers join via joinzap; Zap offers price-comparison listings and a marketplace with category-based commission.

claims.claim: In-app native checkout on Facebook/Instagram Shops was always US-only, so Israeli Shops never had it; Meta also wound down US native checkout in 2025. Israeli sellers checkout on their own site. Catalog management is via the Meta Graph API.
claims.raw_snippet: Facebook and Instagram Shops drive discovery; checkout for non-US merchants happens on the merchant's own website. Meta retired US native checkout in 2025.

claims.claim: Facebook Marketplace is the C2C/local listing surface referenced for personal sales.
claims.raw_snippet: Facebook Marketplace lets people list items for local sale; C2C listings arrange payment directly between buyer and seller.

claims.claim: Instagram (instagram.com) shopping product tags drive discovery to the merchant's external checkout.
claims.raw_snippet: Instagram shopping tags link products to the merchant's catalog and external website.
Zap (zap.co.il) is Israel's main price-comparison and marketplace site.

claims.raw_snippet: רשות המסים: עוסק פטור מול מורשה, ספי מחזור, ומע"מ.

claims.claim: Instagram Shopping for business (catalog, product tags, eligibility) is documented on Meta's business site.
claims.raw_snippet: Instagram for business covers shopping, product tags, and catalog setup.

claims.claim: Israel Post (israelpost.co.il) offers domestic business shipping for marketplace orders; domestic couriers include HFD, Cheetah, and Baldar.
claims.raw_snippet: Israel Post provides domestic shipping options and rates for businesses.
